
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /sandbox                                   │
  │  Sandbox                                    │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Confine auto-mode shell commands with the macOS seatbelt sandbox.

  Usage:
    /sandbox
    /sandbox on
    /sandbox off

  Details:
    Confines filesystem writes for shell and test commands:
    
      • (no args) — Interactive on/off menu
      • on        — Writes limited to the working directory, temp and caches
      • off       — Auto-mode commands can write anywhere you can
    
    Only applies in auto mode, and only on macOS. Reads, network access
    and running programs are never restricted. Persists in settings as
    sandbox.auto_mode.

  Examples:
    $ /sandbox
    $ /sandbox off

  Related: /auto  /settings
